results.title: Policy for AI in Education - Teaching and Learning Innovation Centre (TALIC)
results.content: Policy for AI in Education. The **six core principles** to AI policy in education are:. Ensuring equitable access for all teachers and students is important. This includes making AI tools accessible across multiple platforms, providing technical support to teachers and students, and implementing special provisions for those in need. Additionally, resources and training should be provided to ensure that teachers and students can use AI tools securely, responsibly, and ethically. It is essential to develop AI literacy among teachers and students. Students are accountable for all work they submit for assessments, including any content generated or used with the assistance of GenAI. By following these steps, institutions can effectively develop and implement an AI policy, ensuring a thoughtful and structured approach to the integration of AI into education.
